results.content: At the Library of the Oslo National Academy of the Arts, Nikolaus Gansterer presents his artistic research practice through two current projects – Contingent Agencies and Shaken Grounds. NOTIONS OF NOTATIONIn the course of the PhD programme at the Artistic Research Center of MDW (University of Music and Performing Arts Vienna), Austria  Nikolaus Gansterer will give a lecture and a practice based workshop on forms of expanded drawing and experimental tactics of subjective mapping. In the context of the 12th International Conference on Artistic Research possible positions and reflections of art and research at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, an exchange on contents and forms of artistic research with the APL – Angewandte Performance Lab (Peter Kozek, Barbis Ruder, Lucie Strecker), Nikolaus Gansterer and Margarete Jahrmann, together with Gerald Bast, Alexander Damianisch and Barbara Putz-Plecko. The artistic research project Choreo-graphic Figures by Emma Cocker, Nikolaus Gansterer and Mariella Greil will present the research catalogue exposition “Choreo-graphic Figures: Scoring Aesthetic Encounters“ at the 10th SAR conference at ZHdK – Zurich University of the Arts.
